sections.heading: 1. Lift close, then wind down
lines: ① Keep loads close, bend your knees.
② Turn with your feet, not your back.
③ An easy walk after work, 5–10 min.
④ Chest and hamstring stretch, 20 sec each.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Pain spreads down a leg, or you get
tingling or weakness — stop and get advice.

slides.title:

caption:
Toto spends all day lifting boxes and furniture, and by knock-off his back and shoulders feel like rocks.

Repeated heavy lifting keeps the same muscles working hard all day. Giving them some recovery time after work can help.

Hybi's reset: keep loads close, turn with your feet, then finish with an easy walk and a few stretches. Massage can help tight, overworked muscles feel easier.

Pain spreading down a leg, tingling or weakness is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
